logp.method_description: Octanol–water partition coefficient was measured by the classical shake-flask method using the standard protocol [68]. First, 1 mg of the Zn (II) complex was dissolved in 10 mL of octanol and water (1:1 v/v) mixture. The mixture was stirred for 12 h and then remained to equilibrate for 1 h until the phases were separated from each other. The amount of the complex dissolved in the organic and polar phases was analyzed by UV–Vis spectrophotometry and expressed as log P as follows: log P = log(CO / CW). where CO and CW refer to the Zn (II) compound concentration in octanol and water phases, respectively.
